steps: Join order_items with orders and category_translation to link items to English product categories.
Filter out canceled and unavailable orders using the business glossary definition of Revenue.
Group by product_category_name_english and calculate total revenue as SUM(order_items.price).
Sort the results by total revenue in descending order and return the top 5 categories.

data.text: I'll execute your plan to find the top 5 product categories by revenue.

args.purpose: Top 5 product categories by total revenue (excluding canceled/unavailable orders)
args.sql:
SELECT 
    ct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN category_translation ct ON oi.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
JOIN products pt ON oi.product_id = pt.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
